name: Massage (Therapeutic)
tagline: A results-driven template for therapeutic massage — book online from day one.
description: A clinical therapeutic-massage site — a cool slate-and-teal palette, a muted-steel secondary and a confident sans display, leading with the outcome, not luxury. Installs a working booking flow: a menu by concern (deep tissue, sports recovery, prenatal, cupping, trigger-point, medical/rehab), three licensed therapists and two treatment rooms as bookable resources, and standard plus card-hold policies. Ships as "Meridian Bodywork".
